Open Container Defined

The term “open container” as used in this ordinance means any bottle, can, glass, cup or other.vessel.which.contains.an alcoholic beverage not in it's original contajner.

The term “open container” shall also mean the original container of an alcoholic beverage and which contains an alcoholic.beverage on which the seal has been broken or.which is otherwise ready for consumption.
